verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਕਰਤ ਸੁਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਇਆਨਪ ਤਊ ਨ ਜਨਨੀ ਅਉਗਨ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau karat sut anik iaanap tuoo na jananee aaugan ur dhaario hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a mother ignores many of her son's amateurish deeds and brings him up with love and care.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੋ ਤਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਗਿਆ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਕੀਏ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਡਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaiso tau saran soor pooran pratagiaa raakhai anik avagiaa ke'ee maar na biddaario hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a warrior abides by his woe/pledge in respect of one who comes in his refuge and despite his showing disrespect does not kill him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਜਲ ਕਾਸਟਹਿ ਨ ਬੋਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਚਿਤ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨੋ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau saritaa jal kaasaTeh na borat karat chit laaj apano hee pratipaario hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a log of wood does not sink in river, since it carries a latent respect that he (river) has helped the tree grow by providing it with life-giving water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਪਰਮ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਗਤਿ ਸਿਖਨ ਕੋ ਕਿਰਤ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਛੁ ਨਾ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥੩੭੯॥
verses.translit_en: taise hee param gur paaras paras gat sikhan ko kirat karam kachh naa beechaario hai ||379||

en.bdb: So is the great benefactor True Guru who like a philosopher stone is capable of turning the Sikhs into gold-like metal. He does not dwell on their erstwhile deeds and by blessing them with Naam Simran, make them virtuous like Himself.  (379)
